tickets.title: The Add-task sheet silently flips its own Task/Goal mode to Goal while the user is typing
tickets.name: D-17 [Major] The Add-task sheet silently flips its own Task/Goal mode to Goal while the user is typing
tickets.notes:
Area: AiSearchModal (opened from add-task-row / composer +) · Found: day 1 · Priority: P2

REPRO
Preconditions: Phone shell, /home, any focused routine. Found incidentally during the 4 Oct verification pass.
1. Tap `add-task-row` ('Add task') on the focus card - the sheet opens with the 'Task' pill active.
2. Type 'buy milk' into the prompt field: the mode stays on Task.
3. Clear it and type 'ZZVERIFY focus routine binding check'.
4. Re-read which mode pill carries `v-btn--active`.

EXPECTED
The Task/Goal mode is the user's choice. If the app wants to suggest a different mode it should prompt, not switch; and a sheet opened from 'Add task' should never end up in Goal mode without a deliberate tap.

ACTUAL
The active pill flips from Task to Goal on its own as the text is typed, with no prompt and no toast. Reproduced twice, with the sheet opened from `add-task-row`. 'buy milk' does not trigger it, so the switch is text-driven. If the user does not notice the pill change, pressing send builds a whole multi-milestone goal plan (parent goal + 7 dated milestones) instead of adding one checklist item - an expensive mis-write to undo, and one that also drags in the title-rewrite defect above.

EVIDENCE
Mode pills before typing: [{"t":"task_alt Task","active":true},{"t":"timeline Goal","active":false}]; after typing the same string: [{"t":"task_alt Task","active":false},{"t":"timeline Goal","active":true}]. The placeholder also changes from 'e.g. "Call dentist tomorrow at 2pm"' to 'e.g. "Learn Python this week"'. The tester first dismissed this as an automation artifact, then disproved that with a plain programmatic input event on the real textarea and promoted it to a finding.
Screenshot: .beta-runs/4-10-Oct-2026/verify-shots/newA-mode-autoflip.png

DONE WHEN
Typing any text into the Add-task sheet leaves the Task/Goal mode exactly as the user set it. If an auto-classifier is wanted, it surfaces as an explicit, dismissible suggestion ('Looks like a goal - switch?') that requires a tap, and a sheet opened from `add-task-row` can never reach Goal mode without one.

tickets.title: A finished agent's card-level 'View result' link and mini-ring state are lost on reopen - they read day-scoped localStorage instead of the persisted reward
tickets.name: D-16 [Major] A finished agent's card-level 'View result' link and mini-ring state are lost on reopen - they read day-scoped localStorage instead of the persisted reward
tickets.notes:
Area: Routine Focus home - agent lifecycle / top bar mini ring · Found: day 1 · Priority: P1

REPRO
Preconditions: A routine whose assigned agent completed its end event in an earlier session and whose day goal item carries a persisted `reward` transcript. On the test account: Wind-down / agent 'Evening recap', last run 4 Oct 15:40, transcript 'Hello World'. localStorage key `agent-status-by-day` absent - i.e. any new session. Carried over from the 2-8 Oct cycle and re-confirmed 4 Oct.
1. Close the browser tab.
2. Open a fresh one, re-apply the 412x839 phone emulation, go to /home and wait for the focus card to resolve.
3. Confirm the focused routine is Wind-down and its checklist row 'Beta Launch & Monitoring' still shows the receipt_long transcript icon.
4. Look for the card's 'View result' link next to the time window.
5. Read the title attribute of `topbar-mini-ring`.
6. Tap `topbar-mini-ring`.

EXPECTED
A run that finished and left a persisted reward restores the card's 'View result' link and the mini ring's 'View agent result' title from server state, and tapping the ticked ring opens the agent result - the documented behaviour of the ticked-ring gesture.

ACTUAL
`.rn-focus-card__result` is absent on all 8 routines; `topbar-mini-ring` title is 'Ticked'; tapping it fires the fallback toast 'Already ticked - A tick is final for the day, today's points are banked against it'. The data is NOT lost: the checklist row keeps its receipt_long icon and the goal item sheet shows 'AGENT RESULT - Updated by Evening recap - end event - 4 Oct 15:40'. Only the card-level affordance that leads there is missing, so this is a lost route to the result rather than lost data.

EVIDENCE
localStorage['agent-status-by-day'] === null on every load. The Agents page, from persisted server state, lists 'Evening recap - 11:30 Wind-down - Finished - Last run Today 15:40' (69 runs, 74% success). Mechanism: apps/web-app/src/pages/RoutineFocus.vue `effectiveAgentStatus(taskRef)` returns `$agent.statusByRoutineId[taskRef] || ''` and only promotes the value when it is ALREADY 'listening' (`if (status === 'listening' && this.taskAgentEndEventDone(taskRef)) return 'finished'`), so an empty volatile store can never reach 'finished'; `agentFinished` and `showResultLink` both key off it.
Screenshot: .beta-runs/4-10-Oct-2026/verify-shots/old6-home-no-view-result.png, old6-miniring-already-ticked.png, old6-agents-page.png

DONE WHEN
With `agent-status-by-day` removed from localStorage, loading /home and focusing a routine whose day goal item has a persisted `reward` shows the card's 'View result' link, gives `topbar-mini-ring` the title 'View agent result', and makes a tap on the ticked ring open the agent result instead of the 'Already ticked' toast - i.e. `effectiveAgentStatus` resolves to 'finished' from the persisted reward whatever the volatile store says.

tickets.title: AI goal builder silently rewrites the user's typed plan title before saving it
tickets.name: D-15 [Major] AI goal builder silently rewrites the user's typed plan title before saving it
tickets.notes:
Area: AI goal builder / AiSearchModal Goal mode · Found: day 1 · Priority: P1

REPRO
Preconditions: Phone shell (412x839), /home, any focused routine. Server day 04-10-2026. Carried over from the 2-8 Oct cycle and re-confirmed by a scoped verification pass on 4 Oct.
1. Tap `composer-add` (the + beside the message box).
2. Tap the 'Goal' mode pill.
3. Type exactly: Ship the Routine Focus beta this week
4. Tap send and wait for the plan to generate.
5. Read the 'Plan Title (will be saved as parent goal)' input's .value (read .value, NOT innerText - reading innerText produced a false 'titles are empty' retraction in an earlier cycle).

EXPECTED
The title the user typed is preserved verbatim as the plan/parent-goal title, or any rewrite is clearly presented as a suggestion the user can accept or reject, with the original still visible and restorable in one tap.

ACTUAL
The Plan Title field comes back pre-filled with 'Ship the Routine Focus beta this 7 days' - the user's phrase 'this week' rewritten to 'this 7 days'. It is presented as the value that will be persisted ('will be saved as parent goal'), with no indication it was changed, no original shown, and no way back other than retyping. The user's own prompt is still visible directly above the field reading '...this week', so the two contradict each other on screen. In the 2-8 Oct cycle the same defect produced the saved goal title 'Ship the Routine Focus beta this 2 days', which persisted across the plan form, the WEEK cascade, the MONTH cascade's linked-week list and /goals.

EVIDENCE
Programmatic read of the form: {"typed":"Ship the Routine Focus beta this week","planTitleValue":"Ship the Routine Focus beta this 7 days","exactMatch":false}. No short-week guard appeared this time (unlike 2-8 Oct), so the rewrite is not tied to the short-week path. The plan was CANCELLED, never saved - confirmed on the /goals Week tab.
Screenshot: .beta-runs/4-10-Oct-2026/verify-shots/old4-plan-title-rewrite.png

DONE WHEN
Typing 'Ship the Routine Focus beta this week' into the Goal composer and sending produces a Plan Title input whose .value is exactly 'Ship the Routine Focus beta this week'; OR, if the builder still proposes a normalised title, the proposal is labelled as such, the user's original string is shown alongside it and restorable in one tap, and the field that actually gets saved defaults to the user's string.

tickets.title: Week-goal progress contradicts the server's own progress in the same response - completed days shown as missed, then "Done" declared two criteria early
tickets.name: D-02 [Major] Week-goal progress contradicts the server's own progress in the same response - completed days shown as missed, then "Done" declared two criteria early
tickets.notes:
Area: Cascade panel (routineFocusModel.buildCascade) vs goalCompletionCriteria.buildMilestoneDays / autoCheckTaskPeriod · Found: day 5 · Priority: P1

REPRO
Preconditions: A week goal with milestones spread across the week; at least one day where the milestone is complete but another linked day goal on that date is not.
1. Complete the Sunday and Monday milestones of a week goal on their own days, leaving one other linked day goal open on each. 2. On Thursday open /home -> period-tab-week and scroll the card to the top. 3. Compare the counter and the day dots with the GoalItem's own `progress` / `milestonesComplete` fields. 4. Open /home/classic and compare the Week Goal Streak widget.

EXPECTED
One number for one goal. The counter, the day dots and the rule text agree with the rule the server actually applies.

ACTUAL
Cascade: "1 / 5 days · Active", Sun 4 = cancel (missed), Mon 5 = cancel, Tue 6 = check. Server, same cache entry, same payload: progress 3, milestonesTotal 15, milestonesComplete 7. /home/classic's Week Goal Streak repeats the cascade's version (Su cancel, Mo cancel, Tu check). Two days later the cascade read "5 / 5 days", statusLabel "Done", complete true, while the server still had isComplete null, progress 6 and 13 of 15 criteria met with two open.

EVIDENCE
Apollo cache GoalItem:6ac28b450f5ccb1f4455adc4 -> {progress: 3, milestonesTotal: 15, milestonesComplete: 7, milestoneDays: [04-10 missed, 05-10 missed, 06-10 complete, 07-10 missed, ...]} while vm.cascade -> {done: 1, threshold: 5}. The milestone items "Scope Freeze and Sprint Roadmap" (04-10) and "Core Routine Feature Refinement" (05-10) both have goalRef = that week item and isComplete true. Root cause: routineFocusModel.buildCascade does `const done = units.filter(u => u.state === 'done').length` and `complete = !!item.isComplete || done >= limit`, where units come from buildMilestoneDays, which marks a date complete only when EVERY criterion on it is complete; autoCheckTaskPeriod's progress counts ANY one complete criterion per child document; and the real gate, evaluateAutoComplete, is `met >= threshold && outstanding.length === 0`. The card's rule text "Week auto-ticks after 5 day goals" describes none of them.

With a week goal where day A has a completed milestone and an incomplete sibling day goal, the cascade counter, the day dots, /home/classic's streak widget and the GoalItem's milestonesComplete/progress all tell the same story, the card never shows statusLabel "Done" while the server's isComplete is false, and the rule line states the rule evaluateAutoComplete actually applies.
